_comment: The authored layer for NPC placements. Nothing regenerates this file: it is the only one
a person edits by hand, and it wins over datos/npcs_reales.json, which a tool rewrites.
One row per placement: map, npc AND cell. The cell identifies it because the same NPC can
stand several times on one map - 18 of them do. Moving one is a remove plus a new row.
{ "map": 241438721, "npc": 1088, "cell": 260, "orientation": 3 }   place or re-face
{ "map": 241438721, "npc": 1088, "cell": 260 }                     place, keep facing
{ "map": 241438721, "npc": 1088, "cell": 260, "remove": true }    take that one out
The last one is the reason this file exists at all: an NPC Ankama places and we do not want
has to be removable without editing the generated file it came from, because that file is
rewritten by tools/extraer_npcs_reales.py and the edit would vanish.
The bankers of the banks no capture shows. Only Bonta's banker is measured (the jss of frame 16

room's own floor shows: the counter is the unwalkable diagonal 258-272-287-301-316-330-345, with
the walkable lane between it and the vault. They take the lane's front row, 273 and 317, facing 3,
the counter, as Bonta's banker does; the derived layer had them on the room's emblem (356, 371).
Bonta's 289 is a cell nobody walks on -- he stands behind his counter -- but where each other bank's
counter is cannot be read off the data (captured NPCs stand on walkable, fight-only and unwalkable
cells alike: 151, 113 and 158), so these stand inside the room, where they can be reached.
